name: Archmage Xylem
summary: In northern Azshara, Archmage Xylem keeps apart from the world. He pursues arcane research in an isolated tower and receives only those who can aid his studies or settle his vendettas.

sections.title: A Recluse Above the Coast
sections.body:
Archmage Xylem lives in a secluded spire above northern Azshara's ruined elven coast. No road or trail reaches his sanctuary. His servant Sanath Lim-yo magically carries approved visitors up the cliffs.

Across Kalimdor, people know Xylem as profoundly eccentric and dangerous to approach. Even fellow scholars treat him with caution. He behaves unlike almost any other human mage.

sections.title: A Grudge Against Morphaz
sections.body:
Archmage Xylem holds a fierce grudge against the green dragonflight, especially the drake Morphaz. The dragon once swallowed one of Xylem's apprentices whole, along with an arcane shard of immense power.

Xylem does not mourn the apprentice. He remains intent on hunting Morphaz and taking the prized artifact from the dragon's belly.

faq.q: How do you reach Archmage Xylem's tower?
faq.answer: No walkable path reaches Archmage Xylem's tower atop a cliff in northern Azshara. Find his servant, Sanath Lim-yo, near the cliffs' base. He can magically carry you to the tower grounds.
In northern Azshara, Archmage Xylem lives in an isolated tower and conducts dangerous arcane experiments away from civilization. The eccentric human archmage keeps apart from the world.

faq.q: Why does Xylem want the dragon Morphaz dead?
faq.answer: Morphaz swallowed one of Archmage Xylem's apprentices whole, along with a shard of immense arcane power. Xylem wants the green drake dead so he can recover the relic from its stomach.

faq.q: Why do people say Xylem is dangerous?
faq.answer: Jediga and other local contacts warn that Archmage Xylem is unpredictable, detached, and distinctly odd compared with other humans.

faq.q: Does Xylem belong to the Alliance or the Kirin Tor?
faq.answer: Archmage Xylem lives as an independent hermit. He does not serve the Alliance military and will deal with any adventurer willing to do his bidding, whatever their faction.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Xylem's supreme mastery of the arcane. His pursuit of magical power in total isolation brings its own unease.
Though human, Xylem will parley with Horde champions who can help with his studies.
As a human, you can see how Xylem has left human society behind. He lives undisturbed atop the wilds of Azshara.
